text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After going out and finishing some shopping
with Tamamo Cross—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Looks like Creek and Oguri
both made it here properly!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head out on the ranch tour right away!
We're counting on you to lead the way, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Let's go pet and pamper
all kinds of animals~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Milk, cheese, yogurt...
I'm sure there'll be lots of delicious things."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, looks like Creek and Oguri headed to where they need to go,
so let's get going too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
'Making needle felt coasters' is...
over that way!
choice_data_list: You're giving this to your family, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it!
I'll make ya somethin' super cool—

text_block_list.name: Ranch Cows
text_block_list.text: Mmooooooo~!!

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, waaaait!!
The stables aren't that waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh, we gotta hurry! The animals are heading
in the exact direction Creek went...!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyo~ne, over here~♪
Cows, sheep, and goats too—
I'll give you all plenty of gentle pats~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, YOU were the one collecting them all along?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haa... The zookeeper looked so troubled, so I'm gonna take all these little guys back where they belong!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The animals finally went back...
Now we can get to making those coasters—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Tama and her Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Did you come to invite me out to play?
...I'm sorry, though. I have milk deliveries to make.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that the staff's job?
Why is Oguri the one doing it??

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The ice cream here is simply exquisite.
Other patrons must have wanted some too, but before I knew it, I had carelessly eaten it all...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So as an apology, I'm carrying milk
to make a new batch of ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see.
If that's the case, I'll help out too!
We'll get it done much faster that way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, the sun had set,
and the ranch's visiting hours came to an end...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Tama... Helping me ended up
eating into your time to make coasters.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry too...
Helping return the little animals to their homes
took up quite a bit of your time, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez! Enough, seriously, enough!
I had plenty of fun, so I've got no regrets!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Because, you see—)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~!
It's way bigger than me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
Look at all the stalls~!
Hey, hey, Tama-nee-chan, let's go check that one out~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't run off!
If there's somewhere you wanna go,
big sis'll take ya there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Siblings
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Whew, that was a lot of walkin'!
My legs are as stiff as boards.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Well, but they've been smiling the whole time.
Somehow... I'm glad it turned out like this.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Things got a bit hectic, but everyone had fun, right?
Then that's all that matters!"
choice_data_list: Get plenty of rest on the way back.
I want to go out with everyone again.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, we do have some time before the bus arrives, to be fair.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I moved around so much,
even I might be totally out of juice... maybe...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my.
It looks like Tama-chan has fallen asleep.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh...
Thank... you kindly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tamamo Cross's peaceful sleeping face
brought a soothing warmth to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right! Be it the mountains or the sea...
with this bunch, we'd have a blast anywhere!
choice_data_list: Let's go wherever you want to go, Tamamo.
Let's go wherever you want to go, Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me what you'd like to do, okay?
Like playing baby-and-mommy, for instance...
I'd be more than happy to be your mama～♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If Creek is Mommy... then I'll be Daddy.
Tama, you can tell Daddy anything."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gwah, every single one of ya!! First the taiyaki guy, now this... I'm a full-grown adult, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, amid a warm and friendly atmosphere,
the ranch tour came to a close.
